`test/e2e/performanceprofile/functests/7_performance_kubelet_node/cgroups.go`|OVN container `cpuset.cpus` assertion now conditional on WP (reserved vs online); ovs.slice effective cpuset parsed and compared to node online CPUs.| |**Affinity collection & verification helpers**

`test/e2e/performanceprofile/functests/7_performance_kubelet_node/cgroups.go`|Rewrote tests to create GU pods, compute union of GU-pinned CPUs, assert OVS excludes those CPUs under WP, and delete/sync GU pods.| |**Reboot persistence & control-plane reboot**
`test/e2e/performanceprofile/functests/7_performance_kubelet_node/cgroups.go`|Affirm OVS/OVN affinity before and after worker reboot; added control-plane reboot validation ensuring OVS matches `reserved+isolated` baseline.| |**ovs-vswitchd thread affinity**
`test/e2e/performanceprofile/functests/7_performance_kubelet_node/cgroups.go`|Updated thread-affinity test to use shared pid/affinity collection and confirm GU-pod pinned CPUs are not subsets of ovs-vswitchd thread affinity, including after pod replacement.| |**Small helpers & utilities**
`test/e2e/performanceprofile/functests/7_performance_kubelet_node/cgroups.go`|Added `createGuPod`, `waitForDeploymentReady`, `collectGuCPUsFromPodList`, `getGuPodCPUs`, `ovsSliceCpuset`, and inserted `GinkgoHelper()` in helper entrypoints.| ## Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant Test as Test Harness participant API as Kubernetes API participant Node as Node (kubelet) participant OVN as OVN container participant OVS as OVS processes Test->>API: Query Infrastructure (CPUPartitioning) API-->>Test: WP enabled? `562-567`: _💤 Low value_ **`BeforeEach` re-checks a value that's already cluster-stable.** `isWorkloadPartitioningEnabled` is computed once in `BeforeAll`. Using `BeforeEach` here re-evaluates the skip on every `It`, which is harmless but wasteful. Switching to `BeforeAll` makes the intent — "skip the whole context if WP is disabled" — clearer and avoids per-spec churn in test logs.
♻️ Proposed change ```diff - Context("Workload Partitioning OVS affinity", Label(string(label.Tier2)), func() { - BeforeEach(func() { + Context("Workload Partitioning OVS affinity", Label(string(label.Tier2)), Ordered, func() { + BeforeAll(func() { if !isWorkloadPartitioningEnabled { Skip("Workload partitioning is not enabled on this cluster") } }) ```
🤖 Prompt for AI Agents ``` Verify each finding against current code. Fix only still-valid issues, skip the rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate. In `@test/e2e/performanceprofile/functests/7_performance_kubelet_node/cgroups.go` around lines 562 - 567, The context "Workload Partitioning OVS affinity" currently uses BeforeEach to skip when the cluster-wide flag isWorkloadPartitioningEnabled is false; change this to BeforeAll so the check runs once for the whole context instead of before every spec—replace the BeforeEach hook with a BeforeAll hook that calls Skip("Workload partitioning is not enabled on this cluster") when isWorkloadPartitioningEnabled is false to avoid per-test churn in logs. ```
--- `937-959`: _💤 Low value_ **Extract the 30-second stabilisation delay into a named constant.** The same `time.Sleep(30 * time.Second)` is used in `getOvnContainerAffinity` (Line 944), `getOvsAffinities` (Line 955), and inline in the WP test (Line 597). A named constant near the top of the file documents intent (waiting for OVS dynamic pinning to converge) and avoids drift between call sites.
♻️ Proposed change ```diff const minRequiredCPUs = 8 + +// affinityStabilizationDelay is the time to wait for OVS dynamic pinning +// to converge after pod creation/deletion before sampling affinities. +const affinityStabilizationDelay = 30 * time.Second ``` …then replace the magic literal at each site with `affinityStabilizationDelay`.

In `@test/e2e/performanceprofile/functests/7_performance_kubelet_node/cgroups.go` around lines 937 - 959, Introduce a named constant affinityStabilizationDelay (value 30 * time.Second) near the top of the file and replace the hard-coded time.Sleep(30 * time.Second) calls in getOvnContainerAffinity and getOvsAffinities (and the inline wait in the WP test mentioned in the comment) with time.Sleep(affinityStabilizationDelay) so the intent ("waiting for OVS dynamic pinning to converge") is documented and the delay is centralized for consistency. ```
--- `588-616`: _⚡ Quick win_ **Duplicates the `getOvnContainerAffinity` / `getOvsAffinities` helpers.** This block re-implements logic that was just refactored into helpers (Lines 937-959), including a bare `time.Sleep(30 * time.Second)`.
